messages:
Sam T.: heads-up — I'm swapping primary for the overnight window (22:00 UTC -> 06:00 UTC). @Priya R. will be primary, @Zach M. secondary. Please confirm PagerDuty, AWS, and Grafana access for Priya before 21:45 UTC. There's an APAC coverage gap if we don't have escalation on-call available. :wave:

oncall-bot: Scheduled rotation: primary -> Priya R. at 22:00 UTC. Reminder: run pre-shift checks.

Priya R.: I can take it. Quick checklist for me: PD escalation policy membership, ability to ack/resolve, Grafana edit/view for prod dashboards, assume-role into ops account, and access to KMS/Secrets so I can check keys if needed. Anything else? :lock:

Zach M.: Also need the PagerDuty mobile push enabled (we had one missed page last week when push was off). Priya make sure your PD user has these roles: EscalationResponder, IncidentResponder. I can add you if you can't.

Nina L.: One more thing — the runbook for on-call access live troubleshooting is here: https://runbooks.redwood.example/oncall/access-checks (useful steps for PD/Grafana/AWS, and break-glass flow).

Priya R.: thanks. Quick status: PD shows me as user priya@redwood.ai, member of "platform-ops-escalation" but not "incident-admins". Can someone confirm whether I need incident-admins to reassign incidents?

Zach M.: You don't need incident-admins to reassign within the escalation policy, but you do need IncidentResponder. I just added IncidentResponder to your PD account (should be immediate). Try triggering a test page on the staging policy (not prod).

Sam T.: test page flow for staging: run `pd trigger-test --policy staging-oncall --user priya@redwood.ai` (we use the internal CLI). If PD push works you'll get a phone/sms/push depending on your prefs.

Priya R.: ran it, got push. :thumbsup:

Nina L.: Grafana: make sure you're in the org group `redwood-oncall` (view+alert). If you need dashboard edit rights for triage, request `grafana-edit` role. Also confirm MFA session for grafana if you're behind SSO.

Priya R.: I can see prod dashboards, but alerts UI is read-only for me. Can someone flip grafana-edit?

Zach M.: done — gave `grafana-edit` for your user for 1h via ephemeral grant. You should be able to mute alerts and annotate graphs.

Priya R.: confirmed.

Nina L.: AWS: you need to be able to assume the `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallOps` role in accounts prod-app and prod-ops. Verify with:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallOps --role-session-name oncall-check
```
If that fails, check SAML/Okta mapping — we recently rotated the SAML assertion for a subset of users and had one mapping drop. Also ensure your MFA device is registered.

Priya R.: `aws sts assume-role` works for prod-app but fails for prod-ops with AccessDenied. @Zach M. can you check the role trust policy?

Zach M.: seeing it — prod-ops role trust got tightened in the last permission sweep. I'll add `role/session` allow for `redwood-saml` group which should restore access in ~5m.

Zach M.: updated, try again.

Priya R.: now succeeds, can list S3 buckets and describe stacks. Good.

Sam T.: reminder: Secrets/Keys — if you need to decrypt anything, use the cross-account grant `secretsmgr:read` via `OncallOps` role. If you need emergency KMS decrypt privileges we need to follow break-glass audit (email secops and open a PD high-priority incident). Don't forget to log actions in the incident thread.

Priya R.: understood. Do we have access to Grafana annotations write for me? I might add notes during incidents.

Nina L.: annotation permissions came with grafana-edit. Also FYI: the dashboards that show tail-latency metrics are in folder `prod/latency` and require panel-level query access — should be fine with your edit role.

Sam T.: APAC gap check — who in APAC is on secondary tonight? We only have one APAC responder on holiday. If a page arrives at 07:00 JST we might have no local responder until 10:00. Either Priya/Zach should be prepared to handle escalation that hits APAC follow-the-sun.

Priya R.: I can handle APAC pages up to 09:00 JST, beyond that please escalate to the on-call rotation owner and consider paging the on-call manager.

Zach M.: I'll be reachable for escalation if Priya needs help. Also leaving a quick checklist for handoff in case we have to pull devs: 1) confirm PD incident assignment, 2) verify playbook step in runbook, 3) annotate Grafana, 4) collect logs via `elk-query` job, 5) escalate to infra if DB involved.

Sam T.: perfect. Final step before swap: Priya, confirm you can ack/resume/resolve in PD (done), assume OncallOps in both accounts (done), and edit Grafana (done). If all good I'll flip the rotation at 22:00 UTC and post a short note in #general.

Priya R.: all green from my side. Thanks team. :rocket:

oncall-bot: Rotation complete: primary -> Priya R. at 22:00 UTC. If you experience any permission issues re-open thread or ping eng-oncall.

Sam T.: thanks — I'll mark coverage in the spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/oncall-coverage (noting APAC gap until 09:00 JST).
